title: Skill (typed operator surface; substrate entity)
description: A skill is an entity in the predication-graph store, per agential-self-generation: skills are entities like agents — a skill that audits skills is itself a skill. Per lab/.../predicated-agentic-orchestration-platform/skill/ (lab's 'predicated-' prefix is pre-grammar-stabilization; cleaner now is just agentic-orchestration-platform — path types it). Carries slug, effectClass (read-only|trace-append|tool-actuation|federation|governance), capabilityBound, surface (tool/script witness), evidence. Side-effecting skills require actionBound and governance references.
